limitations: The speech bubble is the sole source of narrative content; no corroborating visual cues confirm the claim’s truth or context.

limitations: No portion of the chalkboard text is fully readable; its content cannot be verified or interpreted reliably.

philosophy_interpretations.interpretation: The visual homogeneity of dress and posture underscores how social roles constrain individual agency, especially when a private demand is delivered as a binding institutional rule.
alternative_interpretations: The attire reflects standard professional norms for the setting and carries no deeper symbolic weight.
limitations: Clothing style alone does not prove identity suppression; it may reflect convention or policy without ideological intent.
